newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London Evening Standard - Dec 10.

text.p: Prepared for Reuters by The Broadcast Monitoring Company

A report into the Channel tunnel fire is expected to report that the fire was started deliberately. It is believed that the fire may have been started by striking tunnel workers, using the strike for their own purposes.
SAINSBURY'S NEAR TO SETTLING TEXAS ROW

Sainsbury's is set to reveal the results of its long standing dispute with Ladbroke over the price of Texas Homecare, the DIY chain it bought from the leisure company two years ago. Some 60 million stg is at stake. Auditors Price Waterhouse have been delayed due to finishing their report on DIY group, Wickes.
CANADIAN UPSTART GLITTERS WITH INDONESIA GOLD COUP
Barrick Gold, the Canadian gold producer looks set become its the world's top gold producer after a coup gave the company control of a $20 billion (12 nillion stg) gold deposit in Indonesia.
